summary: Implemented proposal review and batch decision UI with server-derived Current/Proposed changes, actual affected requirements, supporting sources, unknowns, qualified confidence, frozen snapshot/token approval, explicit stale refresh, capability gates, pending guards, deep-link recovery and selection identity validation. evidence.result: Reviewed workspace/run/proposal identity lifetime, aborted preview loads, exact snapshot decision request, mutation failure handling, batch-result persistence after pending count changes, and modal focus integration.

limitations: Browser tests and full build not run by this worker to avoid resource contention. Lead started integrated browser lane after source freeze.
The late-arrival/partial-outcome browser case uses mocked live run and batch-result responses; other approval/staleness cases use real API/storage.
No commits, pushes, deployments, full suites, or changes outside assigned product/test files and this result envelope.
